messages:
Taylor: FYI client (BlueHarbor) wants a fast POC next week. requirements list: SSO w/ SAML + OIDC, per-customer subdomain routing, SCIM delta syncs, group->role RBAC, domain proof, and pricing impact for ~30k users initial import. who can own infra/security asks?
Sam: I can take infra. routing: we support mapping by hostname or email domain, with a routing table per tenant. fallback to default IdP if mapping missing.
Priya: security notes: require a scoped service account for SCIM (least privileged), rotate creds, audit logs for provisioning events retained 1yr. domain proof options: DNS TXT or verification email to admin address. if they need BYOK for SAML signing we support KMS integration.
Sam: SCIM details: SCIM 2.0 supported. delta via PATCH and full bulk via /Users import. defaults: 100 reqs/min/org, page size up to 1000. recommend dry-run for bulk import and offer migration assistance for large imports. example PATCH snippet included in doc.
Taylor: pricing question: does heavy provisioning push them to Dedicated?
Priya: no, Dedicated is for inference throughput. auth/provisioning are I/O bound; hosted pricing covers it. we can offer a one-time migration service fee or temporary rate-limit increase under contract.
Taylor: action items: @Sam stand up staging tenant and demo routing, @Priya prepare security checklist and domain proof instructions, I'll draft a short quote mentioning migration fee and possible temporary rate bump.
sec-bot: staging tenant created (id: bh-staging-03) by Sam at 2026-03-22T17:14:xxZ
Sam: I'll provision staging and share endpoints today. Priya, can you confirm retention policy extension options for logs?
Priya: can extend to 3yrs for enterprise contracts, note in checklist.
Taylor: thanks team, scheduling pre-POC sync with client tomorrow. :calendar:
